answer: Each attempt carries 70 stamped dockets, each costing £61 to have checked, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. One name, one proof, one entry: Tinbound iron miner winding writ enforces it, and a writ miners sign after seam checks is how the check runs. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. lantern stays on the record. The clerk notes echo. The basalt is checked, not assumed.
